sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.33 "TIM output override register (TIM_OOR)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1125.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 OOC: Output override control
This bit forces the idle state of the tim_ocx and tim_ocxn outputs to the values defined with
OOSx and OOSxN bits.
0: tim_ocx and tim_ocxn outputs are in the default idle state
1: tim_ocx and tim_ocxn outputs are forced in an idle state defined with OOSx/OOSxN bits
Note: This bit can only be modified when the outputs are in idle state (MOE = 0). It is cleared
when the MOE bit is set.
Bits 11:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 OOS4N: Output override state for output tim_oc4n
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc4n when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc4n = 0
1: tim_oc4n = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 6 OOS4: Output override state for output tim_oc4
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc4 when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc4 = 0
1: tim_oc4 = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 5 OOS3N: Output override state for output tim_oc3n
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc3n when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc3n = 0
1: tim_oc3n = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 4 OOS3: Output override state for output tim_oc3
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc3 when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc3 = 0
1: tim_oc3 = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 3 OOS2N: Output override state for output tim_oc2n
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc2n when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc2n = 0
1: tim_oc2n = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 2 OOS2: Output override state for output tim_oc2
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc2 when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc2 = 0
1: tim_oc2 = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 1 OOS1N: Output override state for output tim_oc1n
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc1n when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc1n = 0
1: tim_oc1n = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bit 0 OOS1: Output override state for output tim_oc1
This bit defines the state for output tim_oc1 when OOC = 1
0: tim_oc1 = 0
1: tim_oc1 = 1
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
